description.value: Your size increases by one size category up to Gargantuan. This causes a +2 increase to your Strength score and -2 penalty to your Dexterity score. Additionally, your unarmed strikes and natural weapons increase by one dice tier up to d12 (d4<d8<d10<d12). You can take this attribute multiple times with stacking benefits, but the cost increases by 2 every time.
